name: The Chronicles of Overlord
detailed_description:
The Chronicles of Overlord is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a fantasy world teeming with conflict between humans, elves, orcs, and other races. As an ancient evil known as the Devastator threatens to engulf the world, only the Overlord — a resurrected master of necromantic power — is aware of the coming doom. To prevent catastrophe, he must claim four legendary artifacts, each guarded by the mightiest rulers of their respective factions.

The game’s turn-based battles demand mastery of positioning, synergy, and terrain advantage. Every encounter presents new challenges, whether facing powerful faction leaders or navigating treacherous battlefields infused with arcane forces. With each victory, the Overlord grows stronger—but so do his enemies.

The Overlord

Once a powerful warrior, betrayed and resurrected through ancient magic to become the Overlord — the Keeper of the Sphere of Death. With this new power and the ability to summon departed souls, the Overlord stands guard over his world.

A World of Might and Magic

A turn-based tactical RPG in pixel art style set in a fantasy world: play as the powerful Overlord and his team, each possessing special magical abilities, attack types, and unique personalities.

Key Features

Tactical Variety

  • Each level presents a new challenge that requires a distinct tactical approach. Position your units wisely, combine hero abilities and spells, and use powerful artifacts and potions to build an effective strategy for every battle.

Unique Heroes and Abilities

  • Each hero comes with a unique skill set and combat role. Progression systems allow you to tailor their abilities to different scenarios and respond effectively to unpredictable situations on the battlefield.

Original Fantasy World

  • Discover a rich, internally consistent world with its own lore, factions, and philosophies of war. Dialogue choices and cinematic cutscenes deepen immersion and reveal the true stakes behind the Overlord’s campaign.

Modern Pixel Art

  • A blend of classic pixel art with modern effects — dynamic lighting, spell animations, and stylized scene direction create a visually striking and immersive experience.
